name: California Statewide Crop Mapping
description: 438,790 California field polygons from the Department of Water Resources / Land IQ Statewide Crop Mapping program. Water-year coverage 2014, 2016, 2018-2024 (2023 + 2024 provisional). >98% crop-ID accuracy; minimum field size 0.5-2.0 acres. Structural caveat: polygons are homogeneous-crop areas, not legal parcels — two adjoining same-crop fields can collapse to one polygon. Already fiboa-native; sourced via the fiboa pipeline on Source Cooperative (source.coop/fiboa/us-ca-scm). CC-0 — reuse without restriction.
